Specification: This specification models a small PlusCal algorithm in which three processes each execute a single statement that assigns a local process variable from a globally defined expression based on the shared variable n. The translated TLA+ spec initializes n to 0, defines helper operators nplus1 and nplus2, and has each process move from program counter state "main" to "Done" after setting its own i[self] to nplus2 and checking an assertion that the assigned value equals 2. The temporal specification requires the standard initial condition and next-state relation, adds weak fairness for each process action, and states a termination property that eventually all processes reach "Done". The design includes an explicit Terminating stuttering action to avoid deadlock after all processes finish.
